summary: On October 23, 2026, the owner requested updating deployment checklists and context in both repositories so verification-record commits do not require another deployment. Keep the source SHA actually deployed when later record/context commits advance main; publication is reconsidered for website-output or deployment-behavior changes, or an explicit owner-requested rerun. CI builds alone create no deployment requirement. This task updates documentation only and does not authorize a deployment or Cursor installation/launch.
